name: glyphpact
description: Compile and verify large SVG sets as deterministic Flutter IconData fonts through a bundled GlyphPact MCP server and project integration skill.

interface.shortDescription: Build reliable Flutter icon fonts from SVG sets.
interface.longDescription: Audit, compile, check, wire, and visually verify large SVG collections as deterministic Flutter IconData fonts while preserving stable codepoints and surfacing every approximation or unsupported source.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $sync-flutter-svg-icons to audit and integrate these SVG icons into my Flutter project with strict fidelity.
